title: Sandpiper's Retreat | Royal Destinations
meta_description: New! Gulf Front with Private Pool and Panoramic Views- Sandpiper's Retreat by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sandpiper's Retreat by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 47 Seagrove Place, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Nestled along the Gulf in the highly coveted 30A community of Seagrove Beach, Sandpiper’s Retreat is a true Gulf-front luxury home offering direct, private access to the sugar-white sands. This exceptional residence features its own attached private beach access directly off the pool deck, complete with umbrella setups provided, creating a seamless connection from home to shoreline. With over 4,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, the home delivers an elevated coastal experience from start to finish. Guests can relax in the private pool and spa, unwind across three expansive poolside terraces with ample seating and gathering areas, or retreat to one of the home’s multiple private suites designed for comfort and privacy. The primary suite offers breathtaking Gulf views and a private outdoor living space ideal for sunrise mornings and sunset evenings. Inside, refined interiors and generous living areas make this home perfect for families, extended families, or multiple groups traveling together. For those seeking a Gulf-front 30A vacation rental with a private pool, spa, and exclusive beach access, Sandpiper’s Retreat offers an unforgettable stay. The only thing missing is you! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front - Private Beach Access - *Private Heated Pool and Jetted Spa (One of the largest pools on 30A) - Over 4,500 Sq Ft - Spacious Outdoor Living Areas With Multiple Sitting Areas - Gourmet Kitchen, Entertainment Room Large Kitchen, Outdoor Kitchen, Wet Bar - Nespresso - Elevator - Parking Spaces: (3) in Driveway + (1) in Carport + (1) Midsize in Garage *Pool Heat is available for an additional $380 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 22 6 Bedrooms / 6 Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: - Bedroom 1: Full Bed, Full XL Loft Bed, Bunk Bed (Full XL/Full XL), Detached Bath (Shower), Double Vanity - Media Lounge, Kitchenette, Island Dining, Washer and Dryer - Pool Lanai, Outdoor Seating, Outdoor Kitchen, Two Outdoor Televisions - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Bedroom 2: King Bed, with Private Bath (Shower), Single Vanity - Bedroom 3: King Bed, Bunk Bed (Full/Full) Private Bath (Vessel Tub/Separate Shower), Double Vanity - Chefs Kitchen, Great Room with Ample Seating, Dining Area, Porch with Dining and Seating, Gorgeous Gulf Views, Half Bath Third Floor: - Bedroom 4: King Bed (Primary), Private Bath (Vessel Tub/Separate Shower), Double Vanity, Desk, Porch with Seating, Loungers, Views - Bedroom 5: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower), Double Vanity - Bedroom 6: Queen Bed, Private Bath (Shower), Single Vanity Amenities Include: - 8 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service - 3 Beach Chair Sets and Front Row Placement (Beach Attendants in Season) Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
